name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-e770a8ab37c1d404118552c172a452b77014882e "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once. It is not defined which of the duplicate definitions takes effect. Defining multiple dynamic templates with the same name will be rejected in a future version."
